sections.name: Auth split page
sections.description: Full-height login/signup page: a narrow form column (wordmark, one headline, SSO buttons first, email fallback, legal microcopy) beside a gradient brand panel carrying a single customer quote or one stat. Login and signup share the template; only the headline, subline and swap link change.

Signup carries the value-prop headline beside the form
Split layout with dark brand panel and testimonial

sections.name: Signup with proof

sections.name: Onboarding preview stepper
sections.description: Setup-in-minutes marketing band: exactly three numbered steps with verb-led titles, one sentence each and a time estimate, summed in the headline. Step 3 is the value moment (the first briefing), and a low-commitment sample path sits beside the CTA.
